title: ln-ashlar Flat Events Index
description: Flat index of all ln-* events for lookup. Generated — do not hand-edit. The detail field is a human-readable signature, not a machine-checkable type. The source field is 'static' (all occurrences proven statically), 'dynamic-allowlist' (all occurrences from allowlist), or 'mixed' (different provenance across emitting/listening sides).

ln-accordion:change.description: Fires from the wrapper after the coordinator has closed other sibling panels.

ln-accordion:destroyed.description: Fires from the wrapper when the component's `destroy()` method is invoked.

ln-ajax:before-start.description: Fires before sending the request. Calling `e.preventDefault()` cancels the fetch.

ln-ajax:complete.description: Fires after clean-up actions have completed.

ln-ajax:error.description: Fires when the request fails (network error or HTTP error codes).
ln-ajax:error.detail: { method: String, url: String, status: Number, data: Object|null, error: Error|null }

ln-ajax:start.description: Fires when the request is sent and loading spinners are attached.

ln-ajax:success.description: Fires upon receiving a successful response (HTTP 2xx).
ln-ajax:success.detail: { method: String, url: String, data: Object }

ln-api-connector:bulk-deleted.detail: { response: Object, ids: Array, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-api-connector:config-changed.description: Dispatched whenever `refreshConfig()` reloads URL, path, and header configuration (including on init).
ln-api-connector:config-changed.detail: { baseUrl: String, path: String, headers: Object, paramKeys: Object }

ln-api-connector:created.detail: { record: Object, tempId: String, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-api-connector:deleted.detail: { response: Object, id: ID, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-api-connector:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

ln-api-connector:error.description: Dispatched upon HTTP or network errors (silent on AbortError).
ln-api-connector:error.detail: { action: String, error: String, status: Int, conflictData?: Object, meta: Object }

ln-api-connector:fetched.description: Dispatched upon delta sync or query responses.
ln-api-connector:fetched.detail: { data: Array, total?: Number, filtered?: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number, since?: String, meta: Object }

ln-api-connector:request-bulk-delete.detail: { ids: Array, url?: String, idempotencyKey?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-connector:request-cancel.description: Aborts in-flight fetch or query for the target element/key.
ln-api-connector:request-cancel.detail: { targetEl?: Element, key?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-connector:request-create.detail: { data: Object, tempId: String, url?: String, idempotencyKey?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-connector:request-delete.detail: { id: ID, url?: String, idempotencyKey?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-connector:request-update.detail: { id: ID, data: Object, expected_version?: Int, url?: String, idempotencyKey?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-connector:updated.detail: { record: Object, id: ID, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-api-queue:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the instance is torn down.

ln-api-queue:drained.description: Dispatched when the outbox becomes empty.

ln-api-queue:enqueued.description: Dispatched when a task is written.
ln-api-queue:enqueued.detail: { entryId: ID, chainKey: String, count: Number }

ln-api-queue:failed.description: Dispatched when 8 retry attempts are exhausted.
ln-api-queue:failed.detail: { entryId: ID, chainKey: String, attempts: Number }

ln-api-queue:nack.description: Rejects transmission; triggers retry, drop, or pause.

ln-api-queue:paused.description: Dispatched when draining pauses for a scope (e.g. after an `auth` nack or manual request-pause).

ln-api-queue:pending-count.description: Emits pending count updates for UI widgets.

ln-api-queue:request-drain.description: Manually triggers a drain attempt — the canonical way to retry `failed` entries (e.g. a UI "retry failed" action).

ln-api-queue:request-enqueue.detail: { chainKey: String, op: String, targetId: ID, payload: Object, expectedVersion?: String, meta?: Object }

ln-api-queue:request-pause.description: Manually pauses queue drainage for this scope.

ln-api-queue:resumed.description: Dispatched when draining resumes for a scope.

ln-api-queue:send.description: Dispatched to coordinator to execute request.
ln-api-queue:send.detail: { entryId: ID, chainKey: String, op: String, payload: Object }

ln-autosave:before-restore.description: Dispatched before filling the form. Prevent default to abort restoration.

ln-autosave:cleared.description: Dispatched after the form's draft entry is removed from localStorage.

ln-autosave:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component is torn down via `.destroy()`.

ln-autosave:restored.description: Dispatched after filling the form and triggering synthetic events.

ln-autosave:saved.description: Dispatched after successfully writing the serialized form state to localStorage.

ln-chart:rendered.description: Rendering notification emitted after SVG geometry updates.

ln-chart:request-data.description: Renderer asks data coordinator for records.

ln-circular-progress:change.description: Fires after the progress values change and the visual SVG is updated.
ln-circular-progress:change.detail: { target: HTMLElement, value: Number, max: Number, percentage: Number }

ln-confirm:waiting.description: Dispatched upon the first click when confirming begins.

ln-couchdb-connector:bulk-deleted.detail: { response: Object, ids: Array, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:config-changed.description: Dispatched whenever `refreshConfig()` reloads URL, headers, and credentials (including on init).
ln-couchdb-connector:config-changed.detail: { url: String, db: String, auth: String, headers: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:created.detail: { record: Object, tempId: String, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:deleted.detail: { response: Object, id: ID, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

ln-couchdb-connector:error.description: Dispatched upon HTTP or network errors.
ln-couchdb-connector:error.detail: { action: String, error: String, status: Int, conflictData?: Object, meta: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:fetched.detail: { data: Array, since: String, meta: Object }

ln-couchdb-connector:updated.detail: { record: Object, id: ID, message: String, meta: Object }

ln-data-coordinator:request-bulk-delete.description: Intake event to delete multiple records.

ln-data-coordinator:request-create.description: Intake event to create a record via fan-out.

ln-data-coordinator:request-delete.description: Intake event to delete a record.

ln-data-coordinator:request-update.description: Intake event to update a record via fan-out.
ln-data-coordinator:request-update.detail: { id: ID, data: Object, expected_version?: String }

ln-data-store:created.description: Emitted after optimistic creation is done.
ln-data-store:created.detail: { store: String, record: Object, tempId: String }

ln-data-store:deleted.description: Emitted after optimistic deletion is done.
ln-data-store:deleted.detail: { store: String, id: ID }` | `{ store: String, ids: Array }

ln-data-store:destroyed.description: Emitted when the store instance is destroyed.

ln-data-store:initialized.description: Emitted when store IndexedDB is configured.
ln-data-store:initialized.detail: { store: String, hasCache: Boolean, lastSyncedAt: Number|null, count: Number }

ln-data-store:loaded.description: Emitted on initial load sync completion.

ln-data-store:query-changed.description: Emitted when store filters, search, or sort are modified.
ln-data-store:query-changed.detail: { store: String, query: { filters: Object, search: String, sort: Object|null } }

ln-data-store:quota-exceeded.description: Emitted on `document` if database storage runs out of quota.

ln-data-store:ready.description: Emitted when data is ready for viewing.

ln-data-store:request-update.description: Optimistically updates a record or rekeys ID.

ln-data-store:synced.description: Emitted after subsequent delta sync completes.
ln-data-store:synced.detail: { store: String, added: Number, deleted: Number, changed: Boolean }

ln-data-store:updated.description: Emitted after optimistic update/rekey is done.
ln-data-store:updated.detail: { store: String, record: Object, previous: Object }

ln-date:change.description: Dispatched on value change (via calendar selection, text blur, or programmatically).
ln-date:change.detail: { value: String, formatted: String, date: Date }

ln-date:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the date picker instance is destroyed.

ln-dropdown:close.description: Fires after the menu is closed, exits the top layer, and listeners cleaned.

ln-dropdown:destroyed.description: Fires when the coordinator's `destroy()` method is executed.

ln-dropdown:open.description: Fires after the menu is promoted to the top layer, positioned, and visually opened.

ln-editor:before-change.description: Dispatched before formatting changes. Canceling aborts format application.

ln-editor:blur.description: Dispatched when focus leaves the contenteditable workspace.

ln-editor:changed.description: Dispatched upon user keypress or markup updates.

ln-editor:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the rich text instance is destroyed.

ln-editor:focus.description: Dispatched when the contenteditable workspace gains focus.

ln-external-links:clicked.description: Dispatched when a user clicks on an external link (useful for telemetry/analytics).
ln-external-links:clicked.detail: { link: HTMLElement, href: String, text: String }

ln-external-links:processed.description: Dispatched after an external link is sanitized and secured.

ln-fill:request.description: Dispatched by coordinators to initiate DOM population.

ln-filter:change.description: Fired on both the filter root and target whenever the filter selection changes. Consumers calling `preventDefault()` claim filtration and prevent default DOM item hiding.
ln-filter:change.detail: { key: String, values: String[], targetId: String }

ln-filter:reset.description: Fired only when transitioning from an active filter state back to the reset sentinel ("All").

ln-form:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the form instance is destroyed.

ln-http:cancel.description: Dispatched on `document` to cancel in-flight requests by key, URL, or all.
ln-http:cancel.detail: { key?: String, url?: String, all?: Boolean }

ln-http:error.description: Fired on the triggering element on network failure (DNS/CORS/loss); never fires on manual or automatic abort.

ln-http:request.description: Dispatched by a consumer (must `bubble` to `document`) to run a deduplicated request; response/error fire back on the dispatching element.

ln-http:response.description: Fired on the triggering element when a request completes (any HTTP status, e.g. 200/404/500).
ln-http:response.detail: { ok: Boolean, status: Number, response: Response }

ln-include:error.description: Dispatched on the host `<template>` when the fetch fails (network error or non-2xx response).
ln-include:error.detail: { target: HTMLElement, url: String, error: Error }

ln-include:loaded.description: Dispatched on the host `<template>` when the partial has been successfully fetched, parsed, and appended to `.content`.

ln-key:before-trigger.description: Dispatched before trigger action executes; cancelable to abort.

ln-key:destroyed.description: Dispatched when shortcut binding is destroyed.

ln-key:trigger.description: Dispatched when shortcut trigger successfully executes.

ln-link:navigate.description: Fires on the host element before initiating redirection.
ln-link:navigate.detail: { target: HTMLElement, href: String, link: HTMLAnchorElement }

ln-list:clear-filters.description: Dispatched to instruct coordinator/store to reset active filters.

ln-list:empty.description: Dispatched when the empty state template is drawn.

ln-list:filter.description: Dispatched in SSR mode when search/filter narrows visible items.
ln-list:filter.detail: { term: String, matched: Number, total: Number }

ln-list:item-action.description: Dispatched when clicking a button marked with `data-ln-item-action`.
ln-list:item-action.detail: { list: String, id: String, action: String, record: Object }

ln-list:item-click.description: Dispatched on item click (ignoring action button, checkbox, and link clicks).
ln-list:item-click.detail: { list: String, id: String, record: Object }

ln-list:page-failed.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

ln-list:ready.description: Dispatched after hydration or initial SSR item parsing completes.

ln-list:rendered.description: Dispatched after items are appended/redrawn in the DOM.
ln-list:rendered.detail: { list: String, total: Number, visible: Number }

ln-list:request-clear-filters.description: Resets all active filters and search term. In Data-Driven mode, dispatches `ln-list:clear-filters` and requests fresh data; in SSR mode, re-evaluates in-memory filters.

ln-list:request-data.description: Dispatched on initialization or parameter changes (sort, search, filter) to request data. Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`) additionally emits `offset`/`limit`/`queryGen`.
ln-list:request-data.detail: { list: String, sort: Object, filters: Object, search: String, offset?: Number, limit?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

ln-list:request-invalidate.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): invalidates the window cache and resets to page 0.

ln-list:request-revalidate.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

ln-list:select.detail: { list: String, selectedIds: Set, count: Number }

ln-list:select-all.description: Dispatched when the global "Select All" checkbox status changes.

ln-list:set-data.description: Populates the list with a dataset, removes loading overlays, and triggers render. Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
ln-list:set-data.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

ln-list:set-loading.description: Controls the visual loading state of the list.

ln-list:sorted.description: Dispatched in SSR mode when items are sorted.
ln-list:sorted.detail: { field: String, direction: String, matched: Number, total: Number }

ln-modal:before-close.description: Dispatched upon request to close; calling `preventDefault()` cancels closing.

ln-modal:before-open.description: Dispatched when state changes to `"open"`, before styles or focus are applied.

ln-modal:close.description: Dispatched after modal closes, before focus restoration.

ln-modal:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component instance is destroyed.

ln-modal:open.description: Dispatched once modal is natively open, body scroll locked, and initial focus set.
ln-modal:open.detail: { modalId: String, target: HTMLElement, hashNs: String?, param: String? }

ln-modal:request-close.description: Command request event sent to close the modal.

ln-modal:request-open.description: Command request event sent to open the modal.

ln-nav:before-update.description: Dispatched before evaluating and updating active link states. Cancelable.

ln-nav:destroyed.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the component instance.

ln-nav:update.description: Dispatched after active link states have been evaluated and CSS classes applied.

ln-number:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

ln-number:input.description: Dispatched upon user input or programmatic value changes.

ln-options:request-data.description: Dispatched on load to request option records.

ln-options:set-data.description: Listens for the array of options to render.

ln-popover:before-close.description: Fires before close, letting the app prevent closing via `e.preventDefault()`.
ln-popover:before-close.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

ln-popover:before-open.description: Fires after attribute changes to `"open"`, before top-layer promotion or placement calculations.
ln-popover:before-open.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

ln-popover:close.description: Fires after popover is hidden, inline styles cleared, and focus restored.
ln-popover:close.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

ln-popover:destroyed.description: Fires when the popover instance is destroyed.

ln-popover:open.description: Fires once the popover is visible in the top layer, positioned, and focus set.
ln-popover:open.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

ln-progress:change.description: Dispatched on construction and every time value or max attributes change.
ln-progress:change.detail: { target: HTMLElement, value: Number, max: Number, percentage: Number }

ln-router:before-navigate.description: Dispatched once per navigation in which at least one region matched, before any region swap or clear. Calling `preventDefault()` aborts the navigation.
ln-router:before-navigate.detail: { from: String, to: String, params: Object, query: Object }

ln-router:navigated.description: Dispatched on each region that mounted a template after DOM replacement and (for the owning region) focus setup.
ln-router:navigated.detail: { path, params, query, route, target, region }

ln-router:not-found.description: Dispatched when no region matches the requested URL.

ln-search:change.description: Dispatched when search term updates. `preventDefault()` skips default DOM show/hide.
ln-search:change.detail: { term: string, tokens: string[], targetId: string, fields: string[]|null }

ln-sort:change.description: Dispatched on the **target** (never on the sort control itself) on trigger click or persisted-state restore. `preventDefault()` hands the sort intent fully to the consumer and skips the default DOM reorder.
ln-sort:change.detail: { field: String|null, column: Number|null, direction: 'asc'|'desc'|'none', targetId: String }

ln-sortable:before-drag.description: Dispatched on `pointerdown` before starting a drag. If canceled, dragging is aborted.

ln-sortable:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the instance is destroyed.

ln-sortable:drag-start.description: Dispatched when dragging commences and pointer capture is acquired.

ln-sortable:enabled.description: Dispatched when transitioning from `"disabled"` to active.

ln-sortable:reordered.description: Dispatched upon pointer release ONLY if the DOM index changed.
ln-sortable:reordered.detail: { item: HTMLElement, oldIndex: number, newIndex: number }

ln-stat:request-count.description: Dispatched on initialization to ask the coordinator to resolve the count.

ln-stat:set-count.description: Received from the coordinator when the count is resolved, triggers rendering.

ln-table:clear-filters.description: Emitted on clear-all button click, before requesting fresh data (Data-Driven mode).

ln-table:empty.description: Emitted when the empty-state template is rendered (SSR and Data-Driven modes).

ln-table:filter.description: Emitted after applying search, column filter, or clear actions locally (SSR mode).
ln-table:filter.detail: { term: String, matched: Number, total: Number }

ln-table:page-failed.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

ln-table:ready.description: Fired once after initial row hydration/parsing completes (SSR and Data-Driven modes).

ln-table:rendered.detail: { table: String, total: Number, visible: Number }

ln-table:request-clear-filters.description: Dispatched to child SSR `[data-ln-table]` element on clear button click.

ln-table:request-data.description: Requests a new data page from the coordinator whenever sort/filter/search state changes, including the initial mount (Data-Driven mode). Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`) additionally emits `offset`/`limit`/`queryGen`.
ln-table:request-data.detail: { table: String, sort: Object|null, filters: Object, search: String, offset?: Number, limit?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

ln-table:request-revalidate.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

ln-table:row-action.description: Emitted on a row action button click (Data-Driven mode).
ln-table:row-action.detail: { table: String, id: String, action: String, record: Object }

ln-table:row-click.description: Emitted on row left-click or `Enter` keypress (Data-Driven mode).
ln-table:row-click.detail: { table: String, id: String, record: Object }

ln-table:search.description: Emitted when receiving an `ln-table:set-search` command (dispatched by `ln-table-coordinator` in response to `ln-search:change`), before requesting fresh data (Data-Driven mode).

ln-table:select.description: Emitted on individual row selection toggle and after select-all (Data-Driven mode).
ln-table:select.detail: { table: String, selectedIds: Set, count: Number }

ln-table:select-all.description: Emitted when the header "select all" checkbox is toggled (Data-Driven mode).

ln-table:set-data.description: Populates the table with a raw dataset (Data-Driven mode). Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
ln-table:set-data.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

ln-table:sorted.description: Emitted after applying a local sort (SSR mode).
ln-table:sorted.detail: { column: Number, direction: String|null, matched: Number, total: Number }

ln-tabs:before-change.description: Dispatched before switching active tab. Calling `preventDefault()` cancels switch and reverts state.
ln-tabs:before-change.detail: { key: String, previousKey: String, tab: HTMLElement, panel: HTMLElement, target: HTMLElement }

ln-tabs:change.description: Dispatched after panel visibility, ARIA attributes, focus, and persistence updates complete.
ln-tabs:change.detail: { key: String, previousKey: String, tab: HTMLElement, panel: HTMLElement, target: HTMLElement }

ln-tabs:destroyed.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the instance.

ln-tabs:request-select.description: Command request event sent to switch active tab.

ln-toast:clear.description: Clears all active toast notifications (optionally filtered by container).

ln-toast:destroyed.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the container instance.

ln-toast:enqueue.description: Dispatches a request to construct and append a new toast notification.
ln-toast:enqueue.detail: { type, title, message, data, timeout, container }

ln-toggle:before-close.description: Fires when the state is about to switch to `"close"`. Prevent default to block the close sequence.

ln-toggle:before-open.description: Fires when the state is about to switch to `"open"`. Prevent default to block the open sequence.

ln-toggle:close.description: Fires after the panel has fully closed.

ln-toggle:destroyed.description: Fires when the component instance is torn down.

ln-toggle:open.description: Fires after the panel has fully opened and classes are updated.

ln-tooltip:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the trigger component instance is destroyed.

ln-translations:added.description: Fires after a language's fields are cloned and the menu/badges are updated.
ln-translations:added.detail: { target: HTMLElement, lang: String, langName: String }

ln-translations:before-add.description: Fires before a language's fields are cloned. `preventDefault()` aborts the activation.
ln-translations:before-add.detail: { target: HTMLElement, lang: String, langName: String }

ln-translations:before-remove.description: Fires before a language's cloned fields are removed. `preventDefault()` aborts the removal.

ln-translations:removed.description: Fires after a language's cloned fields are removed and the menu/badges are updated.

ln-translations:request-add.description: Requests activation of a language programmatically. Event listener is bound to the container element (`data-ln-translations`), not `document`.

ln-translations:request-remove.description: Requests deactivation of a language programmatically. Event listener is bound to the container element (`data-ln-translations`), not `document`.

ln-upload:before-remove.description: Fires before a file is deleted/removed.

ln-upload:cleared.description: Fires after `clear()` wipes all file instances.

ln-upload:destroyed.description: Fires when component instance is torn down.

ln-upload:error.description: Fires when an upload or delete request fails.

ln-upload:invalid.description: Fires when a file fails extension/size/count validation.

ln-upload:progress.description: Fires on XHR upload progress updates.

ln-upload:removed.description: Fires after a file is deleted from server and removed from DOM.

ln-upload:request-clear.description: Inbound command to clear all files.

ln-upload:request-remove.description: Inbound command to remove a file.

ln-upload:uploaded.description: Fires after a file successfully uploads (2xx response).

ln-validate:destroyed.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

ln-validate:invalid.description: Dispatched when the field transitions to an invalid state.

ln-validate:request-validate.description: The submit gate — the first `data-ln-validate` field to initialize on a form injects `novalidate` and attaches a form-level `submit` listener that dispatches this event on the form to collect invalid fields before allowing submission.

ln-validate:set-custom.description: Sets a manual custom error key on the input.

ln-validate:valid.description: Dispatched when the field transitions to a valid state.
